In which year was the total production of cars of types D2 and D3 taken together, equal to the total production of cars of types D4 and D5 taken together?
solution:
**Given:-**Table which represents the data of production of different car type in different year.

**To find:-** The year in which production of D2 and D3 is equal to the total production of D4 and D5 when taken together

Calculation**:-** The total production of cars of **type D2 and D3 taken together **in each year are-

In 2012,

(D2)15 + (D3)20 = 35

In 2013,

(D2)11 + (D3)15 = 26

In 2014,

(D2)15 + (D3)12 = 27

In 2015, 

(D2)14 + (D3)13 = 27

The total production of cars of type D2 and D3 taken together in each year are-

In 2012,

(D4)5 + (D5)19 = 24

In 2013,

(D4)8 + (D5)15 = 23

In 2014,

(D4)18 + (D5)9 = 27

In 2015,

(D4)15 + (D5)25 = 40

**We can see that in year 2014 the production of car type D2 and D3 is equal to the production of car type D4 and D5 when taken together.**
